IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'CUSTOMERACCOUNT_DEP') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.CUSTOMERACCOUNT_DEP;
END;

WITH TEMP_CustomerAccountSK AS (
    SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CustomerAccountSK),0) RN FROM dw.DimCustomerAccount_CM139_20231129  
)
--FOR DEP FILTER
,CustomerAccountParticipation_DEP AS (
    SELECT distinct * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation_CM139_20231129_D1 WHERE SourceSystemCode IN ('DEP') AND (PeriodEndDate = '1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000' OR PeriodEndDate = '2099-12-31T00:00:00.0000000')  
    AND DeletedIndicator = 'N' AND VerifiedIndicator = 'Y'
)
,

FINANCIALPRODUCTAPPLICATION 
AS(
    SELECT distinct A.* FROM BNKM.FinancialProductApplication_CM139_20231129 A
	JOIN (SELECT FinancialProductId, FinancialInstitutionId,FcbsApplicationId, SourceSystemCode, MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp FROM BNKM.FinancialProductApplication_CM139_20231129 GROUP BY FinancialProductId, FinancialInstitutionId, FcbsApplicationId, SourceSystemCode ) B
	ON A.FinancialProductId = B.FinancialProductId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.SourceSystemCode = B.SourceSystemCode AND A.FcbsApplicationId = B.FcbsApplicationId  AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp
)
,
CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory AS (
    SELECT A.* FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory_CM139_20231129 A
    JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId,RecordTypeId,SerialNumber,MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory_CM139_20231129
    GROUP BY CustomerAccountid,RecordTypeId,SerialNumber,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode) B ON A.CustomerAccountId = B.CustomerAccountId
    AND A.SerialNumber = B.SerialNumber AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.SourceSystemCode = B.SourceSystemCode
)
,
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT AS (
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM TEMP_CustomerAccountSK)  AS CustomerAccountSK
,* FROM (


--FOR DEP FILTER
SELECT DISTINCT 
DDC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,BC.CustomerId AS CustomerID	
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCAP.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeSK AS AccountHolderTypeSK
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBR.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDAHT.ShareIndicator AS ShareIndicator
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,DDA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
FROM 
CustomerAccountParticipation_DEP  BCAP
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId,PeriodEndDate, ProductId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode from  BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_CM139_20231129 WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP') CAFP ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = CAFP.CustomerAccountId AND BCAP.FinancialInstitutionId = CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId AND CAFP.PeriodEndDate IS NULL
LEFT JOIN FINANCIALPRODUCTAPPLICATION FPA ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,CAFP.ProductId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,FPA.FinancialProductId) AND CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerId, CoreCustomerId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode from BNKM.Customer_CM139_20231129) BC ON BCAP.CoreCustomerId = BC.CoreCustomerId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer_CM139_20231129 DDC ON BC.CustomerId = DDC.CustomerID AND DDC.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory BCAPAS ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BCAPAS.CustomerAccountId AND BCAP.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAPAS.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCAP.SerialNumber = BCAPAS.SerialNumber
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount_CM139_20231129 DDA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID --AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank_CM139_20231129 DDB ON BCAP.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccountHolderType_CM139_20231129 DDAHT  ON BCAPAS.RecordTypeId = DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeID AND DDB.BankSK = DDAHT.BankSK AND BCAP.SourceSystemCode = DDAHT.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId, CustomerId,BranchID,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode from BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNT_CM139_20231129) BCA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch_CM139_20231129 DDBR ON BCA.BranchID = DDBR.BranchID AND DDBR.CurrentIndicator = 1
WHERE CAFP.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%')
AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')


    ) A
)

SELECT * INTO DW.CUSTOMERACCOUNT_DEP FROM TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT;

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'TEMP_DW_DimCustomerAccount_DELTA_DEP') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.TEMP_DW_DimCustomerAccount_DELTA_DEP;
END;


WITH
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
   CONVERT(bigint,CustomerSK)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerID)
    ,CONVERT(bigint,AccountSK)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,AccountID)
    ,CONVERT(int,AccountHolderTypeSK)
    ,CONVERT(int,BankSK)
    ,CONVERT(int,BranchSK)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,ShareIndicator)             
    )) HASHROW, CustomerID, AccountID, BankSK,  SourceSystemCode, AccountHolderTypeSK
    FROM DW.CUSTOMERACCOUNT_DEP
)
,
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
  CONVERT(bigint,CustomerSK)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerID)
    ,CONVERT(bigint,AccountSK)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,AccountID)
    ,CONVERT(int,AccountHolderTypeSK)
    ,CONVERT(int,BankSK)
    ,CONVERT(int,BranchSK)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,ShareIndicator)             
    )) HASHROW, CustomerID, AccountID, BankSK,  SourceSystemCode, AccountHolderTypeSK
    FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount_CM139_20231129 WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 
)
,
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA
AS
(
    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.AccountID,TGT.AccountID) AS AccountID
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerID,TGT.CustomerID) AS CustomerID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BankSK,TGT.BankSK) AS BankSK
    ,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
    ,ISNULL(SRC.AccountHolderTypeSK,TGT.AccountHolderTypeSK) AS AccountHolderTypeSK
	,CASE
        WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TGT TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID
AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
AND SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
AND SRC.AccountHolderTypeSK = TGT.AccountHolderTypeSK
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR (TGT.HASHROW IS NULL)
)

SELECT * INTO DW.TEMP_DW_DimCustomerAccount_DELTA_DEP FROM TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT 
SET
 ValidEndDate = GETDATE()
,CurrentIndicator = 0
FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount_CM139_20231129 TGT
JOIN DW.TEMP_DW_DimCustomerAccount_DELTA_DEP DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
 AND DELTA.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
  AND DELTA.AccountID = TGT.AccountID 
    AND TGT.SourceSystemCode = DELTA.SourceSystemCode
     AND TGT.AccountHolderTypeSK = DELTA.AccountHolderTypeSK
  AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN DW.CUSTOMERACCOUNT_DEP SRC 
ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK 
AND SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID 
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
AND SRC.AccountHolderTypeSK = TGT.AccountHolderTypeSK
WHERE TGT.CurrentIndicator = 1 and TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP';

INSERT INTO DW.DimCustomerAccount_CM139_20231129 (
CustomerAccountSK
,CustomerSK
,CustomerID
,AccountSK
,AccountID
,AccountHolderTypeSK
,BankSK
,BranchSK
,ShareIndicator
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)
SELECT 
CustomerAccountSK
,CustomerSK
,SRC.CustomerID
,AccountSK
,SRC.AccountID
,SRC.AccountHolderTypeSK
,SRC.BankSK
,BranchSK
,Convert(varchar,ShareIndicator) as ShareIndicator
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SRC.SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
FROM DW.CUSTOMERACCOUNT_DEP SRC
JOIN DW.TEMP_DW_DimCustomerAccount_DELTA_DEP DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId  
AND DELTA.BankSK = SRC.BankSK 
AND DELTA.AccountID = SRC.AccountID 
--AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode 
AND DELTA.AccountHolderTypeSK = SRC.AccountHolderTypeSK 
AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');
